text:
Asha (PM): quick thread to frame a small Q3 pilot for the 'Efficiency Adviser' (batching + prefix cache hints + quant recs + eval alerts). want a minimal spec we can ship to 2 pilots.
Ben (Eng): propose minimal infra: prefix-cache read/write + lightweight batching coordinator. keep DSL tiny.
Ravi (ML): we need a nightly concordance check. thresh proposal: flag if >2% of examples change meaningfully.
Clara (Solutions): SEs need an ROI template CSV. fields: tokens_per_session, sessions_per_day, cost_per_token, expected_reduction_pct.
Asha (PM): ok sketch of pilot scope: enable read-only recs in Console + one-click batching preset + nightly eval alerts to Console/Sentry. acceptance: feature flag, <1 extra API call, ROI CSV for SEs, concordance job running.
Marta (ProdOps): add checklist: telemetry events, SLI for batch latency, rollback playbook, security tag for enterprise customers.
Ben (Eng): sample batch DSL (tiny):
```
batch_policy:
  id: quick_win
  max_wait_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 2000
```
Ravi (ML): pseudocode for concordance job:
```
orig = run(val_set)
quant = run_quant(val_set)
if compute_concordance(orig, quant) < 98.0: alert('quant-warning')
```
Asha (PM): prioritization: pick two things for Q3 pilot: 1) Console read-only recs + ROI CSV, 2) prefix-cache infra + small batching preset. enterprise controls later. sound good?
Clara (Solutions): yes, and I'll recruit AcmeHealth + Shoply as pilots to validate ROI and alert noise.
Ben (Eng): will spike prefix-cache this week.
Marta (ProdOps): adding JIRA checklist now.
ops-bot: created OPT-912 Efficiency Adviser pilot (assignee: Asha).
Asha (PM): great, locking unless objections. launch line: "Reduce inference cost safely with explainable recommendations." :rocket:
